career_spells.employer: NATSEM, University of Canberra (precise payroll entity unverified)
career_spells.role: Research fellow; Senior Research Officer documented in 2007
career_spells.evidence_note: Frozen CV uses Research Fellow; contemporaneous 2007 paper uses Senior Research Officer. Keep one umbrella pending promotion dates. NATSEM is a university research centre, not a Treasury department or AMP employee. Hours and historical institutional control unresolved. July2009publication identifies authors as from NATSEM Pty Limited; UC2009financial report says remaining50percent acquiredSeptember2009. University association does not alone settle payroll entity or historical government control. Do not assume wholly university-owned throughout2005–09. UC2008financial statements explicitly report50percent ownership with no present ability of control in National Centre for Social and Economic Modelling Pty Ltd(ACN095483686). Thus UC affiliation cannot establish university control in2008. Other shareholding/control arrangements and her payroll entity still require evidence. The2009report acquisition date is15September2009, not an inferred first day of September; no employment transition is assigned to that corporate event. Former NATSEM staff2023history identifies original co-ownership as Ann Harding and the University, narrowing the previously unnamed counterpart lead; continuity/voting rights during2005–09 and personal payroll remain unverified.

research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01. Complete known frozen employment sequence retained and supplemented with contemporaneous NATSEM title, volunteering and party/community governance. No documented private-enterprise spell found in reviewed material; this is not evidence of zero private experience.

Follow-up: full CV or employment records for precise NATSEM/Treasury dates and substantive hours, any leave or secondments, and 2009/2010/2015 transitions; historical UC control; NATSEM title progression. Funding and commissioned AMP reports do not make the employer public or private by themselves.

Follow-up: Belconnen board/presidency anchor dates and remuneration, earlier student jobs if any, and 2018–19 interval after Macklin role. Do not infer leave from parenthood. Parliamentary maternity leave in 2021 is documented separately from pre-election employment.

Searched official/own biographies and first speech, public professional profile, historical university annual report, university research portal, contemporary NATSEM paper, board-history and full-time/leave queries. Correct LinkedIn profile alicia-payne-4bab9a28a was indexed but direct open returned Internal Error without detail. Other people named Alicia Payne and vacancies for her staff excluded.

UC report initially opened but later-page request returned (400) Timeout fetching. NATSEM paper supplied independent contemporaneous institutional/title evidence. Its full-time model assumptions refer to study subjects, not Payne. Hours remain null, totals not calculable; no invented January boundaries or overlap sums.

Follow-up2026-10-02: contemporary NATSEM publication and university acquisition disclosure identify a material legal-entity/control complication: September2009purchase of remaining50percent means university affiliation cannot be treated as continuous sole ownership. Precise payroll entity and government control remain unresolved, and university category retained pending clarification.

BCS2016audit signature anchors presidency at4October2016. A public Instagram search snippet mentions2013–16but full page was throttled and account attribution/term meaning not recovered; retain as lead, not tenure boundaries.2014–15audit indexed president listing corroborates, but direct web inaccessible and ordinary download returnedcurl22HTTP404.

UC2009report initially accessible; targeted later-page request returned400Timeout. Search-index-only ownership and audit details explicitly labelled. Treasury hours, NATSEM promotion, all precise boundaries, earlier paid jobs,2018–19gap and board fees remain open. Next avenues: historical joint-venture owners/constitutional control and authentic employer CV/appointment records.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: a dated local report published 2 September 2018, immediately after ACT Labor's preselection count, described Payne as most recently the former chief of staff to Jenny Macklin. This establishes that the Macklin role had ended by that observation point, but not the cessation day or month. The interval from that role to election remains unresolved; candidacy and campaigning are not presumed paid employment.

Follow-up2026-10-04: UC2008financial statements explicitly identify50percent shareholding with no present ability of control in NATSEM’s legal company(ACN095483686), materially strengthening the historical control warning. UC2009index refines corporate acquisition to15September2009; neither event is a personal employment boundary. A2011original microsimulation article’s author details identify Treasury affiliation, but publication can lag research and supplies no appointment or hours, so no tenure extended. A Harding tribute suggests initial co-ownership but full page inaccessible; not used to conclude historical control across all years. Board/resignation searches did not resolve further terms. Continue historical joint-venture governance and personal workload/leave research.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Recovered readable NATSEM staff founding history naming Ann Harding as original co-owner alongside UC. Materially narrows historical ownership lead; no assumption of unchanged2005–09shareholding, voting control or payroll. Contemporary UC2008no-control finding preserved. Job advertisements and speeches describing other workers were rejected as personal-hours evidence. Treasury boundaries/leave, early paid jobs and2018–19work remain open; target attributable staff contract and historical company governance records next.
